[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Bendlar Kovings''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at [[Drop Point: Gelgelar|Drop Point Gelgelar]]. He was the supply depot's Communications Officer and Flight Deck Officer.
